strNotes: Requires Phobos Framework 0.12.0+ and the Shipbreaker plugin. Includes wall processing, grabber, chute, paired residue collection and a 4 x 4 scrap reclaimer. New wall jobs produce identified residue; the reclaimer recovers steel/aluminium and retains rejects. Old jobs and unclassified residue keep their original meaning. Reclaimer Control Panel and phobosreclaimer commands open feed and controls; room atmosphere receives process heat. Native station stock, construction and maintenance included. No ejection or attached-hull cutting. Ordinary saves supported; in-game compatibility remains subject to testing. Translation catalogs use Framework language selection. Version 0.9.0 adds explicit automatic reclaimer feeding from processors or collector buffers, separate input/output pairs, saved receiving filters and phobosroute commands. Routing and processing require separate Start and pause after reload. Version 0.10.0 adds a 3 x 3 industrial console, local equipment Control Panels, grouped ship overview, search, attention and routing. Remote control requires a powered console on a player-owned host ship; docked neighbours remain separate. Requires Phobos Framework 0.12.0+. Equipment names now follow the Phobos' maker/model convention; saved identifiers are unchanged.
